text: The Toronto Investment Board ("Board") received a recommendation from the Integrity Commissioner to develop a personal trading policy ("policy"). The Board referred the item to staff to work with the Integrity Commissioner to develop this policy. The policy is now complete (Attachment 1) along with an annual disclosure (Attachment 2).

The Toronto Investment Board: 1. Requested the Executive Director, Corporate Finance to amend the Personal Trading Policy for Board Members as described in Attachment 1 to the report (October 30, 2018) from the Executive Director, Corporate Finance to reflect the request that the City Clerk's Office will act as record keeper of the annual compliance statements. 2. Adopted the Personal Trading Policy for Board Members as described in Attachment 1 to the report (October 30, 2018) from the Executive Director, Corporate Finance, as amended by Part 1 above.
